Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery call today — great context on Medify's self-service intake flow and the recent throughput goals you shared. Quick recap of the outcome and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: Validate integration approach and latency targets for the real-time inference path (90k req/day, median latency target ~50ms per call)
- Next meeting: Technical deep dive + preliminary architecture walkthrough (1hr)
- Stakeholders we think would be helpful: Eng lead, infra owner, and one of our Solutions Engineers to demo the runtime and routing rules

We have the following 1-hour windows available next week (all times PT):
- Tue 9/1 10:00–11:00 PT (13:00–14:00 ET)
- Wed 9/2 14:00–15:00 PT (17:00–18:00 ET)
- Thu 9/3 08:00–09:00 PT (11:00–12:00 ET) — early option if your infra team is east-coast heavy

Can you confirm which slot works best and who on your side will attend (names + roles)? I can send the calendar invite with a Google Meet link and attach a short agenda + a draft SOW for alignment.

Agenda (high level):
- 10m introductions & goals
- 20m architecture & integration approach
- 20m live demo of the runtime + KV cache behavior
- 10m Q/A and next steps / mutual action plan

Thanks — Camila
